title: Creature from the Greenlake
subtitle: The poor, sweet girl and the terrifying monster are classic characters in horror movies.

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: Today I'm going to read you The Frightening Hunter! I wrote it yesterday!

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: Read it! Read it!

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: This is the story of a hunter. The hunter is tall and muscly and of great frame. He can twist steel rebar with his bare hands, and no one can lift his arms up by a hair's thickness and escape from him.

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: The hunter lives in the campsite, deep in the woods. He would slaughter every living thing that breaks into his territory.

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: One day, a group of college students came into the forest.

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: They enjoyed their time there, drinking and dancing. When it comes to the night, the strongest of them disappeared.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: Oh? Where did he go?

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: The hunter killed him! He hung the boy's head on the tree and turned to the girl with the blonde hair.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: Oh!

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: She also soon breathed her last breath. The third victim is the clumsy short guy, followed by the nerdy tall guy.

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: At last, the hunter came up to our protagonist, the kind, naive girl.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: That was the first story she ever told me.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: An intriguing, interesting story.

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: This is a story of Jessica.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: How nice! You are here again. It's been a month since you last showed up here.

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: Just like the character we've seen in the movies, she is a kind, introvert, virtuous girl.

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: The friends of hers took her to a beautiful campsite next to a lovely lake. This would be the perfect place for a swimsuit party.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: You've grown taller. Can you get up so I can see better?

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: What they didn't know is that, deep in the water, a defeated, evil army is in hiding.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: Why are you frowning?

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: Countless demonic war beasts were roaring restlessly to be unleashed, and an evil plan has been hatched. A massacre was about to take place.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: What can I do to make you feel better, Jennifer?

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: Yes, a nightmare indeed. Jessica ran as fast as she could, kept pushing herself to go faster and faster until her ankles could not support one more sprint, and she rolled into a muddy pond.

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: The monster with dark fur and a bloody mouth was right behind her. Then ...

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: Are you crying? Jennifer?
Jennifer, we gotta go. Where are you?

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: Oh, no. It's Mom. I'm here. I'm here!

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: Yes, so you are crying, Jennifer.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: Oh. Aren't you taking the notebook with you? Why are you throwing it into the lake?

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: I really like this place, but I'll probably never come back here again. I gotta go.

items.speaker: Jennifer
items.text: See you, Jessica.

items.speaker: Deer Sockpuppet
items.text: Okay.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: See you, Jennifer.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: That was the last story she told ...

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: I didn't understand what she meant by "see you," for she has never actually "seen" me.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: After that, I also haven't seen her for a long, long time—feels like for ages.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: I went through every corner of the campsite and collected every item I could possibly find, making stories out of them, one after another.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: But who is there to tell? There's no one in the woods anymore.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: At first, I spent my days with my furry friends.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: They were my loyal listeners, and I taught them how to act and behave like the "monsters" in the stories.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: We played the stories, one after another. It was great fun. But the stories got old. No exceptions.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: This is when those young people came into the woods, like the protagonists in our stories. They arrived with their friends, and each of them have different relationships with one another.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: We had a good time, but I would think about Jennifer a lot.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: When I started to believe that I will never see her again, she's back.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: She came back with many people who I have never met before, as well as a "camera" that I have never seen.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: She was here to make a "movie," which is a word I used to hear a lot from her. I understand it to be a kind of story that could be stored in a box.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: I'm glad that she is still passionate about horror movies, like what I have been feeling in all these years.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: They were short of one "actress," and I know what that word means.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: A brilliant idea came to my mind.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: I joined them.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: I was like the monster in the stories that hides in the group. She will be so surprised when she finds out what I did.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: However, an accident happened. There were other people in the forest.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: Ah, misfortune. What a misfortune!

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: Jennifer was upset. She got into a fight with a strange man.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: I called upon the rain, bringing these people into my story too.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: They accomplished a good story!

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: The man who knows a lot about horror movies, the woman who is always calm, the woman who seems strange, and the woman who smells like a puppy. They are all very interesting people.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: I think I start to like them. They are different to the people I met before, who always cried and fainted very quickly, not long after my story started.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: They are interesting and of great fun.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: So I want to tell them the truth and make friends with them.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: I have to let them know about this, that ...

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: My real name was never Anne. It's Jessica.

items.speaker: Jessica
items.text: This is the last surprise I've prepared for you. Now, enjoy!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Anne! She jumped!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Blonney! Watch out for the critters!
